gaps.assumed: 0 l/min, nothing subtracted (the pumped flow is read as flow available to the new load)

gaps.how_to_get_it: The selected rear-door unit's datasheet at the site's water temperature and airflow.
gaps.input: Rear-door heat exchanger capacity per rack
gaps.why_it_binds: Decides whether the rear-door scenario can host the target rack at all. When absent the engine uses a library default of 60 kW per rack (band 20-80), which is neither a manufacturer's rating nor a site measurement.

gaps.assumed: 0 kW, nothing subtracted (busway_ampacity_A is read as the whole installed total)
gaps.how_to_get_it: Branch-circuit or busway monitoring (peak kW over a representative month), or the sum of the metered rack loads on the busway.
gaps.why_it_binds: The busway result is the installed capacity as declared; the load already drawing from it is not subtracted, so the racks it can still feed are overstated by that share. When this is given the engine subtracts it (never below zero); when absent nothing is subtracted.

gaps.assumed: not supplied: no occupied count is known; every position that is not free is read as occupied for the busway check only (an assumption, E0), and nothing else uses it
gaps.how_to_get_it: The tenancy schedule or the floor plan's rack register: racks physically installed, which is not the same as positions sold.
gaps.why_it_binds: Only the busway check against the load already in the hall reads it: the racks already installed are counted from this figure at the hall's design density. When absent the engine does not know how many positions are occupied; it reads every position that is not free (hall.rack_positions less hall.positions_available) as occupied, an assumption (E0) that is only as good as the total, and says so. Zero is a statement (nothing is occupied) and is asked for when free positions equal the total. It changes no rack count, cost or date.

intake.recommended_engagement: Intake too thin for a full study. Sell the Density Screen instead: it produces the binding constraint and the data-request list, and its fee credits against the study when the data arrives.
warnings: Busway: neither hall.occupied_positions nor hall.rack_positions was supplied, so the occupied count is an assumption (E0) from the library default total of 400 positions, not a count of anything in your hall. Reading that total less your 180 free positions as occupied (220 positions), at their 8 kW design density, would draw 1,760 kW, more than the 1,290 kW the declared busway can carry. busway_ampacity_A is read as the installed total and existing load is not subtracted, so check whether the figure you gave is the whole hall's busway, and give hall.occupied_positions and hall.rack_positions (a full intake takes both) so this check runs on counts rather than an assumption.
No transformer schedule supplied: transformer capacity is not evaluated and may be the true binding constraint.
No UPS schedule supplied: the load is treated as unprotected.
No behind-the-meter options declared: where the grid binds, the study can only report that it binds.
